body:
The next bounded D06 slice will reproduce and qualify MMC1 banked PRG-RAM. This does not expand D06 into implementing every mapper in the emulator.

Ownership: `/root/d04_foundation`, branch `feat/d06-banked-ram`, isolated worktree `/tmp/retro-d06-banked-ram`, from actual main `31713b08b851312e0f82d7723e81e90500c7da8f`. PR #58 remains unchanged and under separate review; root remains the sole merge owner. Heavy native/browser work waits for the D11 measurement window to finish.

Scope correction: the [approved delivery plan](https://github.com/TuringTestee/retro-coop/blob/ecf6bd4c7443526f0a163b721a351c854ee90fd4/docs/implementation/browser-nes-audit.md) defines D06 through compatible persistence/restore and measured ten-second/32-MiB rewind. Representative bank-changing, RAM/battery and regional evidence is required. The 18 remaining unvalidated mapper variants are an inventory gap, not automatically 18 required D06 implementations. D20 owns the reviewed advertised-compatibility matrix; missing core features require bounded proposals, not an implicit promise of universal support. Existing arbitrary supported local ROM admission will not be narrowed.

Upstream check: current main is our existing pin `a0a6b17f8ba9c5ee451453fb2409753fd06e5a31`. Latest released tetanes-core 0.17.0 has package/tag provenance `94e3db3684ced606c6865c51a9a61b0e15bc08fe`. The actual published crate and both Git revisions contain the identical MMC1 source blob `a34d663e86ade4d0ca972fc7e55177372ebc7ab0`: PRG-RAM always maps bank zero, and extra-register selection compares the retained raw address only to literal C000. Published crate SHA-256 matches registry metadata `c12a52c1ee5d08354b57b57e858367518e9a7a266ad19ca65138ceb054d831c4`. Switching to the release does not fix either issue. [Pinned source](https://github.com/lukexor/tetanes/blob/a0a6b17f8ba9c5ee451453fb2409753fd06e5a31/tetanes-core/src/mapper/m001_sxrom.rs), [release](https://github.com/lukexor/tetanes/releases/tag/tetanes-v0.17.0).

Next: create an original CPU-written banked-RAM fixture, record before-failure on the unchanged pin, then implement only the demonstrated mapper correction through reproducible versioned dependency source. Preserve a single upstream mapper owner, pin/provenance, offline build support and a strategy to replace the patch when equivalent upstream code passes the same regressions. No shared Cargo-cache edits. Battery/state import transactionality and core-identity behavior remain required evidence. No runtime patch precedes the reproducer.
